summary: This document is a resume for Prakhar Praveen, a Software Development Engineer with experience at Amazon Inc. and as a Graduate Teaching Assistant at Arizona State University. The resume highlights his skills in Java, Python, SQL, backend development (Spring Boot, REST/gRPC), distributed systems, cloud platforms (AWS), data and machine learning, and quality/DevEx practices. It also details his projects, including a Psychometric Intake Engine, a Movie Recommender System, Language & POS Tag Models, and participation in a Software Security CTF. He holds a Master of Science and a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science from Arizona State University.
